_note: Input to: node tools/music/midi2song.mjs --batch tools/music/songs.json [--preview]. One entry per song file in content/music/. file is relative to _root. Optional overrides: lead/bass/harm (part keys as the report prints them), start/bars (window, in bars), res (steps per beat). year is the original release year and is what the anachronism rule in content/music/playlist.json is checked against. month (required, 1-12) is the release month of the same release: the first release, single or album, whichever came first. _month says where it comes from. A same-year song released after its level's month is a warning in the build log and the Music panel, never a refusal.
